articles.summary: Businesses invest heavily in generating leads and demand, but a persistent problem remains: many leads fail to convert into appointments, sales, or revenue. The issue is not unresponsiveness, but breakdowns among marketing, sales, and operations that may block customer interest from becoming outcomes. articles.title: Turning Conversation Data Into Revenue: Why Businesses Need to Act on Performance Gaps
